artifact.subject: COX fusion run 1 -- f12feb2516 (intersection encoding) and its union re-cut @1f5d4f6136 (+ restamp ab8a2276bb)
artifact.snf_implementation: Wang et al. 2014 as written here: P = W/(2*rowsum) off-diagonal with 0.5 self-mass; S = row-normalised K-NN kernel (stable argsort tie-break, ascending index); each iteration P_v <- S_v (mean of other P) S_v^T, re-normalised and symmetrised; fused = mean(P_v), symmetrised. float32. K=20 T=20.
what_reproduces_exactly: view2 derivation counts 5,110 / 4,215 / 19 / 48 and pair extremes 1,702,992 at 1.0 / 6,487,694 at 0.0
sec-6.3 predicate FALSE on both frames

what_diverges.mechanism_named: two SNF implementations differ in normalisation detail (COX's fused carries 297,780 exact zeros and max 0.00485 -- sparser, less re-normalised; mine re-normalises every iteration and carries no exact zero). Rank AUC is invariant to monotone rescale but not to which pairs tie at zero, so ~0.02 is the expected size of this class. Neither number is 'the' fused AUC; the SIGN and the 6.3 verdict are implementation-independent, the second decimal is not.

stability_null.scheme_note: MY SCHEME: permute view 2's entity labels, fuse with W1 half b, compare against fused(W1 half a, W2 unpermuted). W1's halves still agree in the control, so this null measures 'view 2 contributes nothing' -- a STRICTER null than relabelling a whole fused matrix. Nulls are scheme-dependent (Addendum 1d); the two seats' nulls compare only under one named scheme.

cause_read_from_the_controls.absent_handling: NOT the cause. T0 0.5358 / T1 0.5347 / T2 0.5317 / T3 0.5355 on the 1,820 both-measured frame -- a 0.004 band.
cause_read_from_the_controls.method_alone: C1 = SNF(view 1, view 1): 0.6665 from 0.7429 raw. SNF's K-NN kernel + diffusion erodes 0.076 with NO second view.
cause_read_from_the_controls.second_view_content: C2 = SNF(view 1, view 2 PERMUTED): 0.5309 vs the real 0.5358. View 2's actual content is irrelevant to the collapse; any second view with its firm-blind marginal flattens view 1 through SNF's cross-diffusion.
cause_read_from_the_controls.parameter_sensitivity: C3 = K=100: 0.5961 vs 0.5358 at K=20. K-sensitive; rank agreement across (K,T) (COX rho 0.9848) is a different property from boundary preservation.
cause_read_from_the_controls.one_line: Where fusion happened, firm separation is lost to (i) SNF's own smoothing (~0.08) and (ii) a second view carrying no firm signal, regardless of content (~0.13 more); NOT to absent-handling; the loss shrinks as K grows. One run, one carrier, one pair of views -- a finding about this experiment's design, not a verdict on SNF.

artifact.frame_A_mixed_scale_caveat: fused+pass-through ranks SNF values (max ~0.04) and view-1 values (0..1) in one pool; 0.5699 is partly a stratum statement. Stratified: pass-through pairs 0.7128 over 227,480; both-measured pairs 0.5358 over 1,655,290.
